technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with RSI and trend-following indicators aligned, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with weak volume confirmation, limiting swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: MAR shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 19 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (357), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings in 19 days create severe macro headwinds for Consumer Discretionary sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI 9, Supertrend, Hull) is bullish in extreme fear regime (VIX 357), offering contrarian entry near support at 132.08 with 4.7% upside to resistance.
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings in 19 days, price below all key moving averages (EMA 21/50, SMA 50), weak volume (CMF negative, OBV flat), no institutional conviction, and macro headwinds (VIX crisis, rising dollar, flat yield curve) create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
